clips.title: The story
paras: Finding Warmth is a humble errand centered on keeping a welcoming hearth fueled with firewood. With the host occupied by other responsibilities, travelers are asked to gather logs so that any soul seeking warmth can find comfort. Completing the task keeps the fire burning and opens the way to further chores.

Finding Warmth is a simple chore undertaken to sustain a welcoming fire. The questgiver keeps an open hearth ready to warm any wandering soul, but mounting obligations have left them unable to gather fuel on their own. By stepping in to collect firewood, travelers ensure the hearth remains alight for anyone seeking shelter and comfort.

Not all timber retrieved from the surroundings is ready for immediate burning. Upon delivery, pieces too damp or wet to catch fire are set aside to dry properly, while seasoned wood feeds the flames right away. Pleased with the timely assistance, the host quickly turns to other pressing matters that still demand attention.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My hearth is open to warm any soul, but I'd like to ask you to help me if you could.
I simply need more firewood. It is something I would normally do myself, but I have been preoccupied by other tasks.

clips.title: Progress
paras: Light guide you on your tasks.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Ah, perfect. These will do--any that are too wet to use right now I will leave to dry.
Now, if you're willing, I have more tasks I could use help with.
